Enterprise Architect (Solutions Engineer), Identity
description_html: Your work days are brighter here.     We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.           About the Team  Workday is strategically expanding into the identity management space to govern access for both employees and AI agents across the enterprise. As enterprise adoption of autonomous agents accelerates, CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs are facing a critical governance challenge: how to manage identity, access, provisioning, lifecycle automation, and least-privilege controls across a combined workforce of people and AI agents.  Workday is establishing a specialized Identity team focused on helping enterprise customers modernize identity governance and access management for this new era of work. As a member of our diverse and skilled Identity presales team, you will have the opportunity to communicate and demonstrate the power of Workday's identity governance capabilities, expected to become part of Workday's Agent System of Record, to prospects and customers. This team sits at the exciting intersection of Sales, Product Management, Consulting Services, Marketing, and Value Management, giving you exposure to all areas of the business while helping customers reduce access risk, strengthen compliance, automate identity lifecycle processes, and unlock trusted AI adoption at scale.  The Revenue organization at Workday is grounded in integrity, innovation, accountability, and collaboration. We are looking for experienced solution architects who can build trusted executive relationships, shape complex security and identity focused sales cycles, and help accelerate market adoption in a strategic growth area for Workday.    About the Role      In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to Workday customers and prospects, crafting the overall identity governance and access management solution strategy to achieve their business objectives. With expertise in identity and security domains and a strong understanding of enterprise SaaS solutions, you will establish yourself as a leader with a valued point of view on how organizations should govern access for both human workers and AI agents.     You are comfortable engaging CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, senior technology leaders, security executives, and ecosystem partners, translating complex identity governance, provisioning, access review, least-privilege, lifecycle automation, compliance, and AI governance requirements into clear, compelling solution strategies and executive-level value propositions.      What you’ll do:       Serve as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers on identity governance, authentication, authorization, and access control strategies.    Architect and deliver technical solutions spanning IGA, IAM, CIEM, and PAM, mapping business requirements into scalable identity architectures.    Lead workshops, whiteboard sessions, and demos that showcase the business value of identity automation, access governance, and zero trust.    Design and implement integration strategies across AWS, GCP, and Azure, with a strong understanding of native identity services, policies, and entitlement models.    Nerd out on protocols and standards like SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, and FIDO2 — and explain them to both engineers and CISOs.    Build, test, and troubleshoot custom integrations and workflows using APIs, SDKs, and Terraform/automation frameworks.    Stay ahead of industry trends (IGA, CIEM, Just-in-Time access, Zero Trust, identity for machine/non-human accounts) and share thought leadership with internal teams and customers.           #identityjobs        About You      We are seeking people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers to understand their needs, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance our platform. If you're passionate about identity security, automation, and making access management seamless for enterprises, we'd love to hear from you.      Basic Qualifications      Enterprise Architect, Identity   ·  4+ years in a technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, or identity architect/engineer role, OR equivalent hands-on experience in IAM/IGA/AI. ·  1+ years focused on identity governance, identity and access management, cybersecurity, cloud security, or related solutions.   Senior Enterprise Architect, Identity  ·   6+ years in a technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, or identity architect/engineer role, OR equivalent hands-on experience in IAM/IGA/AI. ·   3+ years focused on identity governance, identity and access management, cybersecurity, cloud security, or related solutions.   Principal Enterprise Architect, Identity  ·  8+ years in a technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, or identity architect/engineer role, OR equivalent hands-on experience in IAM/IGA/AI. ·  5+ years focused on identity governance, identity and access management, cybersecurity, cloud security, or related solutions.        Other Qualifications      Foundational understanding of authentication, authorization, identity services (Okta, Entra AD, LDAP, Google Workspace), and cloud IAM basics.    Practical knowledge of directory services (Okta, Entra ID, LDAP, Google Workspace, on-prem AD).    Hands-on cloud experience with AWS IAM/IAM Identity Center, GCP IAM, and Azure AD/role-based access models, including how to govern them with IGA.    Comfort with GO, APIs, SDKs, JSON/YAML, scripting, and automation, Terraform or similar IaC tools.    Great communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.    Curiosity about identity security and drive to deepen technical knowledge over time.    Willingness to travel for customer meetings, partner events, or industry conferences.    Industry-recognized certifications (CCSP, CISSP, AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)    You enjoy building new things and presenting new ideas.    You love helping customers understand and solve their access management challenges.        Travel is a required element of this role. The position requires up to 25% travel monthly        VISA Sponsorship   is not  available for this role  .     Workday Pay Transparency Statement     The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below.  Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please    click here   . The application deadline for this role is the same as the posting end date stated as below:           01/31/2027    Our Approach to Flexible Work      With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply   spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field   with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. title: Markets Technology - Site Reliability Engineer, VP

description_html: Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.     As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.     Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.       Position Overview:    The Site Reliability Engineer is based in North America (NAM) to serve as the regional pillar of our global reliability engineering function within Markets Technology. In this role, you will be part of a distributed, high-impact three-person global team, working closely with your counterparts in EMEA and APAC to provide resilient, round-the-clock ("follow-the-sun") operational excellence, infrastructure automation, and architecture reliability for mission-critical enterprise systems.   As a VP-level Individual Contributor, you will operate as a technical authority for the NAM region. You will champion modern SRE principles—bridging software engineering, systems architecture, and production operations—to maximize service uptime, optimize performance, and drive end-to-end automation across hybrid-cloud and on-premises environments.    Key Responsibilities:    Reliability Engineering, Observability & Incident Governance     SLO/SLI Framework Ownership:  Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Error Budgets across core regional and global platforms in collaboration with development and product teams.   Incident Management & Root Cause Elimination:  Act as the Tier-3 technical escalation authority for critical production incidents during NAM market/operational hours. Conduct blameless Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and implement preventative architectural and automated remediations.   Advanced Observability:  Design and maintain unified monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting ecosystems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog) to ensure deep system telemetry and proactive anomaly detection.     Automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Continuous Delivery     Toil Elimination:  Identify repetitive operational tasks and eliminate toil through software engineering, creating resilient tools, automated runbooks, and self-healing infrastructure.   Infrastructure as Code & Configuration:  Architect, provision, and maintain secure, highly available cloud and bare-metal environments.   CI/CD Pipeline Reliability:  Partner with application engineering teams to design robust, secure, and automated release deployment patterns (Canary, Blue/Green, Feature Flags) that minimize change failure rates and deployment friction.     Global "Follow-the-Sun" Collaboration & Hand-Offs     Global Continuity:  Execute structured, high-context operational and incident handoffs with counterparts in EMEA and APAC, ensuring seamless 24/7 reliability coverage without requiring overnight on-call shifts.   Global Standardization:  Align regional operational standards, automation scripts, and disaster recovery procedures with the global pod to maintain parity across regions.   Regional Change & Regulatory Windows:  Oversee critical change execution, patching, and deployment windows specific to the NAM time zone and regulatory environment.     Architectural Resilience, Chaos Engineering & Capacity Planning     Resiliency by Design:  Partner with Solutions Architects to review system designs against non-functional requirements (NFRs), high availability (HA), and multi-region failover capabilities.   Capacity & Cost Optimization:  Forecast infrastructure capacity requirements based on business traffic growth patterns, optimizing compute, storage, and networking utilization across NAM data centers and cloud zones.     Qualifications:    Experience     Experience Level:  6+ years of professional experience in Software Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Architecture, or Systems Engineering, with at least 4+ years dedicated to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or Production Engineering at a senior/lead level.   Industry Background:  Prior experience in highly regulated, mission-critical, or high-throughput environments (e.g., Financial Services, FinTech, Tier-1 Tech, Enterprise SaaS) is strongly preferred.     Technical Competencies     Software Development / Scripting:  Advanced proficiency in at least one core programming language (Python, Java,) and shell scripting (Bash) for tooling, automation, and API integration.   Cloud & Container Orchestration:  Deep expertise with Kubernetes (OpenShift), Docker, and enterprise cloud platforms (AWS).   Infrastructure as Code (IaC):  Extensive experience writing and maintaining modular Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible codebases.   Operating Systems & Networking:  In-depth knowledge of Linux/Unix internals (kernel tuning, I/O bottlenecks, memory management), networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, Load Balancing, TLS/mTLS, HTTP/gRPC), and distributed system failure modes.   Database & Storage Systems:  Familiarity with relational databases and distributed data stores/messaging systems from a reliability, backup, replication, and failover perspective.   Observability Tooling:  Hands-on experience configuring and scaling telemetry stacks.     Leadership & Interpersonal Attributes (Individual Contributor)     High Autonomy & Ownership:  Demonstrated capability to operate independently as the sole regional subject matter expert while maintaining strong synergy with global peers.   Communication & Stakeholder Management:  Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical issues and trade-offs to senior leadership and cross-functional engineering teams.   Problem-Solving & Bias for Action:  Calm under pressure during high-severity production incidents, with an analytical mindset focused on data-driven decision-making.     Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)     Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) & Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)  across NAM service components.   Service Availability & SLO Attainment  against target thresholds.   Toil Reduction Rate:  Quantifiable percentage of operational tasks automated and transitioned to self-service.   Change Failure Rate & Rollback Frequency:  Reduction in deployment-related service disruptions.   Quality of Global Handoffs:  Zero-drop continuity across NAM/EMEA/APAC shift transitions.     Education:    Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience  Master’s degree preferred     This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.                ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Applications Development            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Jersey City New Jersey United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $142,320.00 - $213,480.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. Citi offers competitive employee benefits, including: medical, dental & vision coverage; 401(k); life, accident, and disability insurance; and wellness programs. Citi also offers paid time off packages, including planned time off (vacation), unplanned time off (sick leave), and paid holidays. For additional information regarding Citi employee benefits, please visit citibenefits.com. Available offerings may vary by jurisdiction, job level, and date of hire.   ------------------------------------------------------    Most Relevant Skills   Please see the requirements listed above. ------------------------------------------------------   Other Relevant Skills   Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud Solutions, Production Engineering, SRE Observability. ------------------------------------------------------   Anticipated Posting Close Date:  Nov 21, 2026 ------------------------------------------------------   Automated Processing and AI    We use automated processing, including artificial intelligence, for our legitimate business interests (or our reasonable and appropriate business purposes) to identify and align the candidate's skills and abilities with a specific job opening. Additionally, if you so choose, or consent, we can match your skills and abilities to other suitable roles at Citi.     Importantly, all our hiring processes and decisions, including determining your suitability for a role, are conducted, checked, and decided by individuals. Our automated processing and AI do not involve relying on automatic or autonomous decision-making. Please refer to any Jurisdictional Considerations, with specific provisions for your country (where relevant) for further details.        Illinois residents – AI Notice and Right     ------------------------------------------------------    Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.             If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review  Accessibility at Citi . Senior solutions architect (UK)
description_html:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. 

 

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.

 

📐 About the role

Every company grows differently, and at WRITER, our growth is directly tied to empowering our users to create better content, faster, and at an unprecedented scale. As a strategic solutions architect, you'll be at the forefront of this mission, working directly with our largest and most strategic prospects to identify, validate, and build innovative generative AI solutions that unlock massive business value. This isn't just about selling a product; it's about deeply understanding complex enterprise needs and architecting a future where AI transforms how our customers operate. You'll be instrumental in shaping how the world's leading companies adopt and scale AI, making a tangible impact on both their success and WRITER’s continued leadership in the enterprise generative AI space.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our London hub. You will report directly to the Director of solutions architecture.

 

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

 - Drive strategic technical discovery with Fortune 500 prospects and customers, translating complex business challenges into clear, impactful technical solutions for AI-powered work

 - Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure generative AI solutions for enterprise clients, leveraging WRITER's platform, APIs, and custom applications to solve critical business problems

 - Lead the development and execution of compelling proofs of concept (PoCs) and demonstrations, building custom templates and integrating WRITER's capabilities to showcase transformative value and accelerate time-to-value for customers

 - Serve as a trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives, VPs of Engineering, and AI leaders, guiding their generative AI strategy and collaborating to define enterprise-level architecture roadmaps

 - Partner closely with WRITER's product and engineering teams, providing critical feedback from customer engagements to influence our product roadmap and ensure our solutions meet evolving market needs

 - Champion the adoption of WRITER's platform and APIs, educating prospects and partners on the art of the possible with generative AI and empowering them to build their own innovative solutions

 

⭐️ What you need

 - 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as solutions architect, enterprise architect, or sales engineering, ideally within a high-growth, B2B SaaS company serving Fortune 500 clients

 - Deep expertise in generative AI principles, large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering best practices, with a passion for staying ahead of the curve in this rapidly evolving field

 - Experience in Python, proficiency with APIs, and end-to-end orchestration, to augment AI workflows and integrate AI capabilities into complex enterprise systems

 - Exceptional communication and presentation skills, able to simplify complex technical concepts into clear, compelling business language for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership

 - A highly versatile and tenured problem solver, capable of leading multi-stakeholder discovery sessions, uncovering root causes, and architecting innovative solutions to complex business and technical challenges

 - A builder's mindset and a proven ability to connect deeply with customer needs, challenge the status quo with innovative AI solutions, and own the technical success and impact of client engagements



🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

 - Generous PTO, plus company holidays

 - Comprehensive medical and dental insurance

 - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

 - Fertility and family planning support

 - Competitive pension scheme and company contribution

 - Annual work-life stipends for:
   
   - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.
   
   - Learning and development stipend

 - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites

 - Competitive compensation and company stock options

title: Senior Enterprise Architect
description_html: The delivery Enterprise Architect (EA) serves as the primary technical driver for delivering high quality Digital Experience and Digital Marketing solutions for Adobe's Global Enterprise customers. Review and develop architectural plans, lead diverse delivery team, align with client goals.   Minimum Qualifications     Past experience in a consultative role leading large-scale enterprise digital marketing ecosystems in the role of Architect and/or Principal Consultant.    4+ years' experience hands-on architecting and/or implementing  three or more  of the following Adobe Experience Cloud solution categories:    Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics    Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign or Marketo Engage    Adobe Real-Time CDP or Audience Manager    Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) including App Builder    Adobe Commerce/Magento or another e-commerce solution that integrated with AEM    Adobe Target or Recommendations    Adobe Experience Platform (Schema, Query Services, etc.)    Adobe Workfront Workflow, Planning, or Fusion    GenStudio, Express, or Firefly Services (< 3 years)      Strong leadership abilities (an example being proactively convert complex business requirements into technical "solutions") which aligns all delivery team activities to documented customer Business Objectives.    Experience producing project scope definitions, delivery estimations, resource allocation and project timelines based on product licensing purchase and implementation requirements.    Ability to quickly diagnose delivery challenges and formulate effective remediation plans to adhere to scope, schedule and budget.    Demonstrable hands-on experience using enterprise platforms (Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, etc.) with an emphasis on REST APIs, Cloud Storage, Structured/Unstructured Data, Security and Data Ingress/Egress.    Experience leading cross-functional, multi-region delivery teams.    Proficient in written and verbal communications with the ability to adjust communications as needed for Technical, Marketing and/or C-Suite customers.    Ability to travel up to 20% of the time within the United States and occasionally internationally.    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (CS), Digital Marketing or MBA or equivalent experience.       Skills that Set You Apart     One or more current Adobe Certified Expert certifications (AEM, AJO, Analytics/CJA, RTCDP, Target or Workfront)    Working knowledge of end-to-end digital marketing journey including Ad Tech (CDP/DMPs, DSPs, etc.), Marketing Automation, omni-channel personalization, Content Management or automation, CRM, Media Execution, and Reporting/Insights.    Hands-on experience architecting and/or delivering native, Flutter or React-Native mobile applications.    Proficiency in employing Generative and/or Agentic AI solutions to optimize daily workflows or hands-on experience with building AI agents.      About Adobe   Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.   Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.     Let’s Adobe together   At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact.
